settings.heading: A new devotion, printed once, gone with the month.
settings.description: Every month we write and print one devotion and prayer on the back of the bag. When the month ends, that bag ends. The next one comes with something new to sit with.
settings.devotion_verse: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
settings.devotion_body: Lamentations was written over a city in ruins. Yet in the middle of his grief, the writer stops and remembers: God’s mercy has not run out. Most of us wake up carrying yesterday. The sharp word, the unpaid bill, the prayer that seems unanswered. But mercy is not a tank that drains. It is more like the sunrise. It comes back whether you earned it or not. Yesterday is finished. His mercy is not.
settings.devotion_prayer: Lord, thank You for this morning. I lay down what I carried in from yesterday. Your mercy is new today. Help me live like someone given a fresh start. Amen.

settings.heading: Written once. Never reprinted.
settings.body: Every devotion on the back of every bag is written for one month, printed on that month's bag, then retired. What arrives at your door won't arrive again. The morning stays fresh because it never repeats.

settings.heading: Six coffees. One devotion each month.
settings.description: Certified specialty beans, small-batch roasted in Bend, Oregon, independently lab tested. On average just over four days between roaster and post.

settings.heading: A simple morning rhythm.
settings.description: No complicated portal. No guilt if you skip. Just good coffee and a few honest words waiting for you.

settings.label: Our promise
settings.heading: Love your first bag, or we make it right.
settings.description: If the coffee or the devotion does not land the way you hoped, email us. We will refund the bag or send a replacement — no script, no waiting. We are not here to keep your money; we are here to keep you in the morning.

settings.heading: Coffee that funds what you care about.
settings.description: Run a month-long campaign with a custom bag and devotion. Your people get fresh coffee; your cause gets a meaningful share of every order.

settings.heading: Coffee with a devotion on the back of every bag.
settings.description:
For Every Morning started with a simple idea: the things we do every day should point somewhere good. A bag of coffee is ordinary. A few honest words on the back of it can make it a small altar.

We roast specialty-grade beans in Bend, Oregon, and write a new devotion and prayer each month. The words are written once, printed once, and never reprinted. When the month is gone, the devotion is gone with it — so the morning stays fresh.

settings.question: When does my bag ship?
settings.answer: Every subscription roasts and ships together at the start of the month. One-off orders roast within two business days and land in about a week.
